title: Gordon Cooper's book: von Braun worked on UFO craft in Nazi Germany

tellings.quote: Gordon Cooper wrote a book, and in that book, he talks about, um, van Braun telling him that they actually worked on on UFO craft in Germany, Nazi Germany.

plain: The rocket engineer Wernher von Braun is said to have told the astronaut Gordon Cooper that they "actually worked on UFO craft" in Nazi Germany. Robert Salas, a former Air Force officer, tells this on Michels' show in 2025, saying it is in a book Cooper wrote, whose title he does not give. If true, it would mean work on such craft began during the Second World War.
